_meta.note: Grok 4.6 (SpaceXAI, 2026-08-12) + GPT-5.6 Cyber (OpenAI). Grok 4.6 benchmark values from Artificial Analysis's independent article (prose-stated, cross-model-consistent) — x.ai's own page shows grouped bar charts that can't be attributed per-model cleanly, so only AAII (61, matches AA) is cross-checked there. GDPval-AA v2 is reported by AA as an ELO (1753) → maps to gdpval_aa_elo (NOT gdpval_aa_v2, which is the %-winrate scale). Pricing from OpenRouter + AA. arena_webdev_elo 1618 from arena.ai WebDev leaderboard (grok-4.6-high, Preliminary). GPT-5.6 Cyber: model + official API pricing only (developers.openai.com); Daybreak blog describes ExploitGym2/ExploitBench qualitatively with no numeric scores (OpenAI-internal, charts are images) — consistent with cyber-variant policy (refusal-boundary variant, capability scores typically unpublished).

models.name: Grok 4.6
models._note: Focus on long-running agents + interactive/visual work. AAII 61 (frontier, in line with GPT-5.6 Sol). Turn-efficient (~53 turns vs ~103 for Opus 5). Pricing unchanged from 4.5 ($2/$6); cache $0.5.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Cyber
models._note: Cybersecurity model for authorized vulnerability research / security testing (Daybreak Red). Trained to improve exploit-development workflows; outperforms GPT-5.6 Sol + GPT-5.5 Cyber on ExploitGym2 (no numeric scores published). $12.50/$75; cache $1.25.
